name: Astral Town
description: The last surviving settlement in the shattered world of Astral. Every adventurer begins their journey here. The guild board, shops, the old inn, and a small pet store lining Market Row are always open.

name: Newcomer's Hollow
description: A soft-mouthed cave under Astral Town, warm and shallow, where the weakest things in the world wander in circles. Every adventurer's first fifty floors are here.

name: Entry Tower
description: A crumbling tower at the edge of town. Weak monsters lurk within, the proving ground for every new adventurer. One ancient guardian waits at the top.

name: Gambit's Dungeon
description: The domain of the trickster Gambit. A labyrinth that shifts with each descent: mirrors show what never was, and shadows move on their own. Kikaru keeps the last floor. The halls below are not champions.

name: Centurion's Dungeon
description: A fortress of endless war. The Centurion's elite legions patrol every hall, growing deadlier with each descent. Celestia holds the last gate. The ranks below her are the test, not masters.

name: The Other Side: Astral Tower
description: A rift between worlds. The creatures here are not flesh, they are pure astral energy given violent form. Bam waits where the tower stops being stone. Nothing on the way up is a master.

name: The End: Eternal Dungeon
description: The final frontier. Those who reach its depths are said to have touched eternity itself. Esteria keeps the last floor. The long walk below is not a row of champions.

name: The Beginning of the End: Sunken Ruins
description: A cathedral swallowed by the tide long before Astral fell, half its spires still stand beneath the waterline. Something in the drowned choir still prays, and it does not want visitors. Season 1 exclusive: grants +10% XP, Fame, and Solars over normal dungeons while Season 1 is active.

name: The End: The Rift Where the World Sleeps
description: A wound torn in the world where the magical air runs thickest. Beyond the veil the End waits, vast, patient, and so saturated with power that the air alone will stop a mortal heart. While its long sleep lies over Astral, to step through is to be unmade on contact. Only when the aura crests, two weeks in, does the way open to those who would end it.

name: The Caged Dimension
description: A shattered pocket of reality with no exit and no ceiling. The creatures here were never meant to exist, sealed away because nothing else could contain them. Even the strongest titled hunters struggle to survive. There are no bosses to conquer, no final floor to clear. There is only the grind, the howl, and the impossible weight of something that should not be alive pressing down on you with every passing second.
